title: I Tracked the Enameling-Studio Fob Through Three Audits After They Cloned Mine

parts.text: They cloned a guest fob and posted it as mine on the studio door. I was forty-one, enamel volunteer, holding a fob that still opened one kiln. At 6:14 p.m. the clone opened the kiln room and, I found, the gold locker. Temporary, the chair said. I photographed the door, both logs, the time. Then a fob I did not recognize used the same ID toward the gold locker. I did not argue the joke. I argued the log. I have learned the difference between a kiln and a line item.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: An unrecognized fob just used my ID toward the gold locker.

social.video_title: They posted a cloned fob as mine on the studio door — Part 1/3
social.description: Guest clone, my ID, a fob toward gold. Would you have followed the log?

parts.text: I followed with the stills. The gold locker took the same ID. The person palmed a vial that was not a studio vial I could see from the camera cone. I was still forty-one, still volunteered, suddenly the only witness with a timestamp. I messaged the board the door still and stayed in the cone. The person looked at the cone, then at the last drawer on the gold side. I added the second still before anyone could call it a vibe. If it is written, it can be applied to the person who wrote it.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: They are at the gold drawer; the board now has the still.

social.video_title: The same ID opened the gold locker — Part 2/3
social.description: A palmed vial, a camera cone, drawer next. The board has the still. Do you stay in the cone?

parts.text: The board locked the gold locker from the office. The person left the vial and the clone on a sticky. Morning recoded all three doors. The chair who called it temporary lost the fob privilege. I keep a fob that opens one kiln. Doors print IDs now, not clones. The studio at 6:14 sounds like a studio, which is to say kiln and nobody's guest ID. I go back to being a person with a receipt. The second photo is for the person who will say they never saw the first.

social.video_title: Morning recoded all three doors — Part 3/3
social.description: Sticky clone, a lost privilege, doors that print IDs. Was temporary ever three doors?
